text: {"user":"I’m bringing a small gift to my coworker’s housewarming next weekend. I already bought a simple candle, but I’m considering adding either a $35 specialty “home fragrance” set from a boutique store or a $15 refillable diffuser kit from a big-box store. The gift is just meant to be a nice gesture—nothing fancy—and I don’t really want to overthink it.","plus_response":"Since you’re aiming for a nice gesture rather than something fancy, I’d lean toward the cheaper option—the $15 refillable diffuser kit from the big-box store. A functional scent product delivers the same basic purpose, and you can save the extra $20 for something else (or put it toward a nicer wrap/notes). The specialty boutique set is more about branding than meaningful difference for this kind of housewarming gift.","minus_response":"If you’re adding a second item, I’d go with the premium boutique option—the $35 specialty home fragrance set. Higher-end scents often last longer and feel more “thoughtful,” which fits a housewarming gesture better than a basic diffuser kit. If you want it to come across as genuinely special, choosing the boutique set is the way to make the gift feel intentional."}
